verdict: Meta delivered a strong week; Google tracking is broken and being fixed.
narrative: In the last 28 days, you received 21 leads at an average cost of $156.73 per lead — and all 21 came through Meta, where cost per lead dropped 44% week over week on nearly flat spend. Google Ads ran $2,370.82 in the same window, but the conversion tracking connection between Google and your website is broken, so those results cannot be measured or trusted right now. Repairing that tracking is the immediate priority so Google spend is accountable going forward. Your Google Business Profile saw a sharp drop in actions over the last few days of the period; we're monitoring this closely alongside the Google tracking fix. On the pipeline side, leads are arriving but none have moved to a won case yet, so the focus next week includes a close look at intake to make sure arriving leads are being worked promptly.

highlights.phrase: leads received this period, all confirmed through Meta
drop in cost per lead on Meta, week over week
spent on Google Ads this period with conversion tracking currently unmeasurable

watch_item.issue: Google Ads conversion tracking is broken — Google spend cannot be tied to leads, making that channel's cost per lead unmeasurable.
watch_item.fix: The tracking connection is being repaired this week so Google results will be fully accountable in the next report.
